discovery: Theoretical prediction and experimental discovery of topological insulators
subfield: Condensed matter physics: topological quantum materials
motivation: Topological insulators changed how we classify electronic states of matter. Kane (with Mele) showed that spin-orbit coupling in time-reversal-invariant insulators yields a Z2 topological invariant, which guarantees protected helical edge and surface states. Molenkamp's group gave the first experimental demonstration, observing quantized edge conduction of the quantum spin Hall state in HgTe quantum wells in 2007. Hasan's angle-resolved and spin-resolved photoemission experiments on Bi-Sb alloys and Bi2Se3 then directly imaged the spin-momentum-locked Dirac surface states of three-dimensional topological insulators. Band topology became something measured, not only predicted. Theory, transport and spectroscopy together created a field that has since spread worldwide, reaching topological semimetals, magnetic topological insulators, the quantum anomalous Hall effect and proposals for Majorana-based quantum devices. The results have been reproduced across many materials, many probes and many laboratories. This is a lasting conceptual and experimental advance of the kind the Prize should recognise.
